subject.title: fix(agents): preserve tabs and newlines in prompt literal sanitization

question: Should tagged untrusted data blocks preserve tabs through a separate block-only policy while inline prompt literals continue stripping tabs and all line breaks?
rationale: The structured-data fidelity goal is reasonable, but current shipped code deliberately keeps inline values single-line to prevent prompt-structure injection; repository evidence cannot choose the permitted block-whitespace boundary.

options.title: Separate block policy
options.body: Retain strict inline sanitization and introduce a narrowly scoped tagged-block policy for approved whitespace preservation.

options.title: Keep strict everywhere
options.body: Reject raw control-whitespace preservation and retain the shipped sanitizer for inline and tagged content.

options.title: Relax globally
options.body: Accept this PR's behavior only with explicit ownership of the increased prompt-structure risk across every caller.

recommendation.title: Separate block policy
recommendation.body: Retain strict inline sanitization and introduce a narrowly scoped tagged-block policy for approved whitespace preservation.

likelyOwner.reason: The strict sanitizer and inline security contract originate from this person's prompt-hardening commit.
